rights_limit: Access to customer, licensed, personal or partner data does not establish ownership or unrestricted cross-customer training rights. A defensible review must identify owner, permitted purpose, geography, retention/deletion, model-improvement permission and audit rights for each decisive dataset; public product access alone closes none of those questions.

This is not an annual 5% materiality hurdle; without a completed-year metric or explicit annualization it is NOT_COMPARABLE with annual benefit illustrations, and all earlier above/below comparisons are withdrawn.

g2_provisional: Not passed: production availability is more visible than incremental causal economics. Product availability or management-described use supports E1/E2 only. G2 requires an eligible-workload denominator, frozen model/version, matched quality-adjusted comparator, full implementation and inference cost, and a reconciliation to recognized revenue, displaced spend, avoided hiring or released capital. Those elements were not found together in the public materials reviewed through the cutoff.
